title: Concavity of the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck torsion function on centered ellipses and its failure on convex domains
summary: Let $u$ be the torsion function of a bounded domain $Ω$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$ for the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck operator, that is, the solution of $-Δu + x\cdot\nabla u = 1$ in $Ω$ with $u=0$ on the boundary. We prove that for every $n\ge2$ there are bounded, centrally symmetric domains whose torsion function is not concave. These domains have boundary with a flat piece and can be smoothed so that the boundary is $C^\infty$, strictly convex with principal curvatures bounded below by a positive constant, while keeping the torsion function not concave.
